first_failures.detail: The original ready phase disabled Record and prevented a second start.
Inserted paragraph nodes caused a false uncertain acknowledgement.

Swift async-main exited when the CF main run loop stopped. Fresh processes alone did not reliably prevent it. A synchronous test-only entry point now keeps the run loop alive until Swift Testing exits with its verdict; deliberate stop and negative controls validate it.
An exact identifier expression selected zero tests; the harness rejected it. A method-boundary selector executes the discovered cases.
Duplicate task app destinations shared one test Bundle ID. Removed the duplicate registration and rebuilt at the single registered task destination; subsequent registration and doctor passed.
